description: The Crescent Textile Mills Limited — Crestex — was registered on 1 May 1950 and describes itself as a vertically integrated composite textile unit in Faisalabad. It spins diverse raw materials into yarn for weaving and knitting across five spinning mills holding 99,984 spindles, weaves on 194 air-jet looms, and processes and stitches the fabric into home textile and institutional garments. Its product range is yarn, greige and processed fabrics, home textile and institutional garments.
